(2) The scene shifts to another part of the room where one girl, now in a yellow sweatshirt, is focused on writing or drawing on paper at a cluttered desk filled with stationery. (3) A woman with her hair tied back enters the frame, holding a toddler in a yellow and white leopard-print sweater; they look directly into the camera with curious and playful expressions.
